messages.text: Frodo. We must speak, and not by letter. Meet me at the Prancing Pony in Bree, Friday at dusk. Come alone, and tell no one where you're going.
I'll be there. Friday at dusk.
Mr. Frodo! The Gaffer's having his birthday supper Friday at six. Rosie's baking her seed cake. You promised you'd come this year, remember? 🎂
Wouldn't miss it, Sam. I'll bring the map of the Shire for your dad.
And Frodo, bring the item from Bilbo's mantelpiece. Keep it in your pocket and don't take it out.
Rosie wants a headcount by noon. Still coming Friday?
